Overview

São Luís is a city in MA with a population of 1,108,975. An island capital with a UNESCO-listed historic center, famous for its azulejo tiles, reggae culture, and Lençóis Maranhenses nearby. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
